properties.description: Reached ONLY through the agent — the other half of req:driving-agent, and dec:idea-human-newcomer-reader is the open question about whether any other human counts. Never expected to know systems engineering (req:no-se-knowledge), so every question reaches them as options with a recommendation first (req:a-question-arrives-with-a-reading). They own the decisions: every move of a Requirement off `proposed` records THEIR word, never the agent's (dec:certainty-derived). `stakeholder` rather than `user` is deliberate and is the design's own claim — they hold the authority and do not operate the tool.
properties.name: The person whose design it is
